integrity: The centered-triangle problem is reduced exactly to a finite union of polyhedral line segments. A bundled exact Q(sqrt(5)) checker exhausts all 1000 tight-facet triples, all 60 nonempty segments, and every candidate extremum of the piecewise-affine objective. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The calculation is specific to the affine regular decagonal plane and does not classify regular polygonal norms in general. A publicly inaccessible 2024 full text is a residual bibliographic risk for an equivalent calculation under later notation.
title: Exact centered-triangle side interval of the regular decagonal Banach plane
